scope: Only supplied final renders and source comparison; no runtime validation

findings.finding: Empty registered shell reveals the green field through its central cavity; white contour and highlights establish glass. Raw neutral render is milky and very bright, but the registered transparency remains readable.

The low horizontal liquid surface and curved lower volume remain inside the shell. Filled versus empty registered images and the gold probe distinguish independent liquid from glass; no visible leak or exposed liquid edge.

Angled 3D view shows a coherent open elliptical rim and inner throat. Front registered view compresses the opening to a small dark slit, and raw neutral highlights nearly erase it; this is a view/readability limitation rather than a demonstrated closed cap.

Long neck, pear-shaped lower body, flared mouth and right loop preserve the source identity. Both handle attachments appear coherent; angled lower attachment has a bright exposed-end-looking glint, but the front view joins cleanly.

Bottle body, long neck and right handle survive the shown 16x24, 24x36 and 32x48 cells. Hollow mouth and fill distinction become subtle at the smallest cell; the probe still establishes the lower liquid role.

optional_polish: If an additional pass is justified, reduce frontal rim highlight enough to retain a dark mouth opening at small size.
Consider slightly less opaque-looking white highlight coverage in the neutral raw rendering while preserving the registered glass contour.
recommendation: Accept these renders for author selection on structural visual grounds. No consequential defect requires another geometry/render iteration. Runtime and actual game acceptance remain unverified.
